A swipe beginning on the wooden bench was ignored because listeners covered only the fruit field. Actual phone bench-to-field zigzag remained at2/16, while a field-start gesture had cut two. Listen on the scene, capture the primary finger, keep field-relative coordinates and exclude header/overlay controls; prevent browser panning only while the game is playing.
